title: Encrypted backup preparation: database login rejected
summary: Windows encrypted credential read succeeded; PostgreSQL rejected authentication with SQLSTATE 28P01. No backup, restore, migration or production modification occurred.

changes.detail: Prepared read-only production identity check and memory-only dump encryption with AES-256-GCM, DPAPI-wrapped random key and archive integrity checks. Backup execution remains untested.
Added hidden password-only replacement mode that reuses the validated connection address, URI-encodes the password automatically, and saves a new DPAPI file without overwriting previous credentials.

validation.name: Credential/network check
validation.detail: DPAPI decryption reached PostgreSQL; SQLSTATE 28P01 rejected authentication before queries. No secret values printed. No retry with the same credential.

validation.name: Syntax
validation.detail: Node --check and both PowerShell parser checks passed.

validation.name: Encrypted backup and recovery
validation.detail: Blocked on a valid existing database password. Backup encryption/integrity and isolated recovery not yet executed. Only about 499 MiB disk free at preflight; restore headroom must be verified before execution.
